testMode: Test mode: no real money moves. The wallet tap is simulated and the money is sandbox money.
needsWallet: Top-ups go to your capped Kassa wallet. Your money mode is set to pay from your own apps, so there is nothing to top up.
addedBody: Test money is in your Kassa wallet. Your agent can spend it under your signed rules.

errors.TOPUP_DAILY_LIMIT: That would go over today's top-up limit, which is your signed per-day cap.
errors.TOPUP_NEEDS_WALLET: Top-ups need the capped wallet money mode.
errors.FUNDING_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE: That card or bank account is not linked any more.
errors.CODE_WRONG: That code does not match. Check the test payment's note.
errors.CODE_LOCKED: Too many wrong codes. Remove this account and link it again.

kassaIdHint: Anyone on Kassa can pay you with this ID. It is public, like a username.
noPayees: No one to pay yet. Add a recipient first: new recipients cool down for 24 hours before the first payment.
reviewHint: Nothing is sent until you approve it with your passkey.
fromLinked: Or add from a linked account

quote.none: Your wallet can't cover this. Add money, or send from a linked account.
quote.unknown: Your bank checks the balance when you send.

sent.title: Delivered in {{seconds}} s
sent.body: {{amount}} reached {{name}}. Simulated payout on the mock bank: no real money moved.
sent.processing: Sent. The bank is delivering it.
sent.auto: Sent without a passkey prompt: it's inside a mandate you signed.

linked.title: Linked accounts
linked.rowHint: Cards and bank accounts you send from
linked.intro: Link a card or bank account once, then send from it next to your Kassa wallet. Each new account is confirmed with your passkey, the same as any new way for money to move.
linked.testMode: Test mode: cards are Stripe test cards and banks are the mock bank. No real money moves.
linked.removeBody: Sends from it stop. Past payments stay as they are.

card.title: Link a card
card.body: Pick a Stripe test card. In production this is the card form from Stripe; Kassa never sees the card number.

bank.title: Link a bank account
bank.body: Any bank, by IBAN or account number. The bank then sends a tiny test payment with a code in its note; type the code to prove the account is yours.
bank.codeBody: {{bank}} sent a tiny test payment to the account ending {{last4}}. Its note has a 4-digit code.

linked.viewOnly: Linking opens the web app, where your passkey is.
